title: The Pig War
description:
In 1859, one farmer, one pig, and two empires nearly went to war. A short, true story from San Juan Island.

Sources: U.S. National Park Service, San Juan Island National Historical Park - 'The Pig War' (nps.gov/sajh/learn/historyculture/the-pig-war.htm); HistoryLink.org essay 5037.
